clustering.conclusion: The best and worst days are NOT adjacent. The usual argument that you cannot dodge the worst without missing the best does not hold on this data. The real problem is that neither is knowable in advance.

note: Measured on the median listed stock, equal weight, split-adjusted. This is a record of what happened, not a prediction, and it is not investment advice.

cautions.hindsight: Every 'missing the N best days' figure is calculated with perfect hindsight. Nobody knows on the morning of a day that it will be one of the ten best.
cautions.survivorship: Only stocks listed today are included.
cautions.median: The median listed stock, not the Nifty.
cautions.not_advice: A description of the past. Not a recommendation.
